title: Dari-King Style Tangy Barbecue Sloppy Joes
originalTitle: Dari-King Style Tangy Barbecue Sloppy Joes
ingredients: 1 medium yellow onion, very finely minced
1 tsp chili powder, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp salt & black pepper
6 soft hamburger buns & dill pickle slices
instructions: Crumble the ground beef and finely minced onion into a Dutch oven or deep skillet with 1/4 cup water (steaming the beef first creates the signature fine, velvety drive-in Dari-King texture rather than large chunks); cook until browned and drain excess fat.
Stir in ketchup, yellow mustard, brown sugar, apple cider vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, chili powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thick, glossy, and deeply savory-tangy.
Spoon generously onto warm soft hamburger buns with dill pickles.
sourceTitle: Pisoma Kitchen · The Dari-King Barbecue Sandwich
